cards.description: 该研究提出CGM模型，利用关节运动的不可预测性（窗口化样本熵）作为混沌信号，引导图注意力权重和专家路由，在自闭症刻板动作检测中显著优于仅基于动作幅度的基线，并在跨数据集上展现泛化能力。
cards.summary: 事实：CGM将每关节每帧的混沌信号融入图注意力logit和专家路由门控，在116个视频片段上达到0.930平衡准确率，比图注意力基线高0.187；在MMASD数据集上复现组件排序，在Panoptic Studio上零样本保持0.86特异性。作者观点：混沌信号是刻板动作检测的关键，可支持视频-only的干预监测。证据边界：样本量有限，跨机构泛化仍需验证。
keyPoints: 混沌张量驱动图注意力：在注意力logit中加入学习到的成对项，使注意力聚焦于不规则关节，并将边权重重新排序至联合不规则配对；零化该张量后94%片段注意力重新对齐。
门控路由：基于同一混沌信号将每帧路由到四个专家中的两个，专家权重跟踪帧级不规则性；消融显示无混沌的路由无可靠增益，而仅混沌调制贡献+0.132。
性能与泛化：受试者分组五折交叉验证下平衡准确率0.930，超越基线+0.187；在MMASD上复现组件排序，在Panoptic Studio零样本特异性0.86（基线≤0.35）。
cards.limitations: 证据基于116个视频片段的受试者分组交叉验证，样本量有限；跨数据集泛化仅在MMASD和Panoptic Studio上初步验证；混沌信号（窗口化样本熵）的计算参数可能影响性能；未与其他模态（如音频、临床评分）对比；严重程度指数的分半信度0.87仍需独立样本验证。
keyPointsEn: Chaos tensor drives graph attention: a learned pairwise term is added to attention logits, focusing attention on irregular joints and re-ranking edge weights toward jointly irregular pairs; zeroing the tensor realigns attention in 94% of clips.

Gated routing: the same chaos signal routes each frame to two of four experts, with expert weights tracking frame-level irregularity; ablation shows routing without chaos yields no reliable gain, while chaos modulation alone contributes +0.132.

Performance and generalization: subject-grouped five-fold cross-validation yields 0.930 balanced accuracy, +0.187 over baseline; component ordering replicates on MMASD, and zero-shot specificity on Panoptic Studio is 0.86 (baselines ≤0.35).
cards.whyItMatters: 刻板动作由运动不可预测性定义而非幅度，CGM将混沌信号结构化融入图注意力与专家路由，为视频-only的自闭症刻板动作监测提供了新路径，并可能用于干预过程中的严重程度跟踪。
cards.titleEn: Chaos-Guided Graph Attention and Expert Routing Improve Autism Stereotypy Detection
cards.summaryEn: Fact: CGM integrates per-joint per-frame chaos signals into graph-attention logits and expert-routing gates, achieving 0.930 balanced accuracy on 116 clips (+0.187 over the graph-attention baseline), replicating component ordering on MMASD and maintaining 0.86 specificity zero-shot on Panoptic Studio. Author's view: chaos signals are key to stereotypy detection and can support video-only intervention monitoring. Evidence boundary: limited sample size, cross-site generalization still needs validation.
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes CGM, which uses the unpredictability of joint movement (windowed sample entropy) as a chaos signal to guide graph attention weights and expert routing, significantly outperforming amplitude-only baselines in autism stereotypy detection and showing cross-dataset generalization.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Stereotypy is defined by movement unpredictability rather than amplitude; CGM structurally integrates chaos signals into graph attention and expert routing, offering a new path for video-only autism stereotypy monitoring and potentially for severity tracking during intervention.
cards.title: 混沌引导图注意力与专家路由提升自闭症刻板动作检测
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on subject-grouped cross-validation of 116 video clips with limited sample size; cross-dataset generalization is only preliminarily validated on MMASD and Panoptic Studio; computation parameters of the chaos signal (windowed sample entropy) may affect performance; no comparison with other modalities (e.g., audio, clinical scores); the severity index's split-half reliability of 0.87 still requires independent sample validation.
cards.originalTitle: CGM: Chaos-Guided Graph Attention and Expert Routing for Autism Stereotypy Detection

cards.description: 该研究提出 InflEns，让 LoRA 专家混合模型的训练权重分配和推理路由都来自同一个固定提示特征空间中的位置博弈，从而在训练前就能检查专家分工，并用分配结果直接指导推理。其新意在于不依赖专家损失训练显式门控；其有用性体现在路由固定后可把有害行为定位到单一专家并只重训该专家。
cards.summary: 作者提出 InflEns：训练权重与推理路由同源于一个位置博弈，玩家在固定提示特征空间中选择位置以最大化自身获得的提示分布份额，不使用专家损失。在由七个安全相关基准组成的语料上，最高份额专家在约 90% 提示上取得最低留出响应 NLL，而打乱分配后约为 15%；方法性能与已发表的学习型门控相当。由于路由固定，可追踪有害行为到单一专家并仅重训该专家，HarmBench 攻击成功率从 0.51 降至 0.02，同时保持指令遵循能力。
keyPoints: 训练分配与推理路由共享同一位置博弈，份额最高的专家在约 90% 提示上具有最低留出 NLL，打乱分配后降至约 15%。
无需训练显式门控，性能与已发表的学习型门控相当；路由固定使有害行为可归因于单一专家。
仅重训对应专家可将 HarmBench 攻击成功率从 0.51 降到 0.02，并保持指令遵循；框架可扩展到任意编码器与数据分布。
cards.limitations: 证据来自作者自建的七个安全相关基准语料与四类核函数设置，约 90% 与 15% 的对比及 0.51 到 0.02 的攻击成功率下降均为该实验条件下的结果；摘要未报告其他任务分布、模型规模或算力开销下的表现，也未给出与学习型门控对比的完整指标，因此结论的普适性仍需独立验证。
keyPointsEn: Training allocation and inference routing share one location game; the highest-share expert has the lowest held-out NLL on about 90% of prompts, dropping to about 15% after permuting allocations.
No explicit gate is trained, yet performance is comparable to published learned gates; the fixed router makes harmful behavior attributable to a single expert.
Retraining only that expert lowers HarmBench attack success from 0.51 to 0.02 while preserving instruction following; the framework extends to any encoder and data distribution.
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法把专家分工从训练后涌现变为可预先检查的设计对象，并让推理路由无需额外门控训练；固定路由带来的可归因性，为定位和修复个别专家的有害行为提供了可操作路径。
cards.titleEn: A Position Game Unifies Expert Specialization and Inference Routing
cards.summaryEn: The authors propose InflEns: training weights and inference routes both come from a location game in a fixed prompt-trait space, where players choose positions to maximize their expected share of the prompt distribution without using expert losses. On a corpus assembled from seven safety-related benchmarks, the highest-share expert has the lowest held-out response NLL on about 90% of prompts, versus about 15% after permuting allocations; performance is comparable to published learned gates without training an explicit gate. Because the router is fixed, harmful behavior can be traced to a single expert and only that expert retrained, lowering HarmBench attack success from 0.51 to 0.02 while keeping instruction following.
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes InflEns, in which both the training allocation of LoRA experts and the inference routing come from the same location game in a fixed prompt-trait space, so expert division of labor can be inspected before training and the allocation itself guides inference. Its novelty is avoiding an explicit gate trained on expert losses; its usefulness is that a fixed router lets harmful behavior be traced to a single expert that can be retrained alone.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The method turns expert division of labor from something that emerges after training into a design object that can be inspected in advance, and removes the need to train an extra gate for inference routing; the attributability of a fixed router offers an actionable path to locate and repair harmful behavior in individual experts.
cards.title: 用位置博弈统一专家分工与推理路由
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from the authors' corpus of seven safety-related benchmarks and four kernel settings; the roughly 90% versus 15% contrast and the drop from 0.51 to 0.02 in attack success are results under those experimental conditions. The abstract does not report performance on other task distributions, model scales, or compute costs, nor full metrics against learned gates, so generality still requires independent verification.
cards.originalTitle: Game-Theoretic Data Allocation for Expert Specialization and Routing

cards.description: 该研究提出机制分层逆问题（MHIP）范式，并设计两阶段物理引导分解方法，将全局不可识别的逆映射转化为条件可识别的子问题，从而从无创眼压测量中估算小梁网渗透率和常规流出易度。新方法在青光眼病例中显著提升诊断准确率，并为生物传输系统的逆问题提供通用计算蓝图。
cards.summary: 论文针对生物传输系统中宏观观测由微观物理与宏观几何乘性纠缠导致的反演困难，提出机制分层逆问题（MHIP）范式。作者设计两阶段物理引导分解：第一阶段在固定参考几何下隔离内在参数，第二阶段用群体临床数据进行经验结构校准，并引入物理校准数据缩放（PCDS）策略。在青光眼案例中，该方法从单次眼压测量估算小梁网渗透率和常规流出易度，回顾性验证显示无创流出易度估计偏差较低；在27个临床队列的消融实验中，完整框架诊断准确率达88.9%，高于朴素基线的37.0%。
keyPoints: 提出MHIP范式，将全局不可识别的逆问题分解为条件可识别的两阶段子问题。
在青光眼案例中，两阶段框架的诊断准确率达88.9%，显著优于朴素基线（37.0%）。
PCDS策略利用少量高保真模拟构建大规模训练集，无需患者特异性3D建模。
cards.limitations: 验证基于回顾性已发表体内数据，非前瞻性临床试验；诊断准确率来自特定27个临床队列的消融实验，外推性需进一步验证；框架依赖群体水平校准，个体化精度可能受限；未提供患者特异性3D建模，几何简化可能引入偏差。
keyPointsEn: Proposes the MHIP paradigm that decomposes a globally non-identifiable inverse problem into conditionally identifiable two-stage sub-problems.
In the glaucoma case study, the two-stage framework achieves 88.9% diagnostic accuracy, significantly outperforming the naive baseline (37.0%).
The PCDS strategy builds large training sets from few high-fidelity simulations without patient-specific 3D modeling.
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法为无创估算眼部流体动力学参数提供了可解释的概率框架，有望辅助青光眼诊断与监测；其两阶段分解思路可推广至其他生物传输系统的逆问题。
cards.titleEn: Two-Stage Probabilistic Inverse Framework Estimates Aqueous Outflow Parameters from IOP Measurements
cards.summaryEn: The paper addresses inversion challenges in biological transport systems where macroscopic observations arise from multiplicative entanglement of micro-scale physics and macro-scale geometry, proposing the MHIP paradigm. The authors design a two-stage physics-guided decomposition: the first stage isolates intrinsic parameters under a fixed reference geometry, and the second stage performs empirical structural calibration using population-level clinical data, introducing Physics-Calibrated Data Scaling (PCDS). In a glaucoma case study, the method estimates trabecular permeability and conventional outflow facility from a single IOP measurement; retrospective validation shows low bias in non-invasive outflow facility estimates, and ablation over 27 clinical cohorts achieves 88.9% diagnostic accuracy for the full framework versus 37.0% for naive baselines.
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes a Mechanistically Hierarchical Inverse Problem (MHIP) paradigm and a two-stage physics-guided decomposition that transforms a globally non-identifiable inverse mapping into conditionally identifiable sub-problems, enabling non-invasive estimation of trabecular permeability and conventional outflow facility from intraocular pressure measurements. The method significantly improves diagnostic accuracy in a glaucoma case study and offers a general computational
cards.whyItMattersEn: The method provides an interpretable probabilistic framework for non-invasive estimation of ocular fluid dynamics parameters, potentially aiding glaucoma diagnosis and monitoring; its two-stage decomposition approach can be generalized to inverse problems in other biological transport systems.
cards.title: 两阶段概率反演框架从眼压测量估算房水流出参数
cards.limitationsEn: Validation is based on retrospective published in vivo data, not prospective clinical trials; diagnostic accuracy comes from ablation experiments on 27 specific clinical cohorts, requiring further validation for generalizability; the framework relies on population-level calibration, which may limit individual-level precision; no patient-specific 3D modeling is provided, and geometric simplifications may introduce bias.
cards.originalTitle: Deconstructing Intraocular Pressure: A Non-Invasive Multi-Stage Probabilistic Inverse Framework

cards.description: 该GitHub项目将82项技能、15个斜杠命令与681个已披露报告模式整合为Claude Code技能包，覆盖24类核心漏洞及企业身份与基础设施攻击矩阵，为漏洞猎人和外部红队工作提供结构化工具集。
cards.summary: 项目事实：Claude-BugHunter是一个面向Claude Code的技能包，包含82项技能、15个斜杠命令和681个已披露报告模式，覆盖24类核心漏洞以及企业身份和基础设施攻击矩阵。作者观点：该技能包服务于漏洞猎取和外部红队工作。以上信息来自GitHub Trending Daily的项目摘要，未经独立验证。
keyPoints: 包含82项技能与15个斜杠命令，用于Claude Code环境
整合681个已披露报告模式，覆盖24类核心漏洞
提供企业身份与基础设施攻击矩阵
cards.limitations: 信息仅来源于GitHub Trending Daily的项目摘要，未核实技能包的实际内容、有效性、安全性或更新维护状态；681个报告模式与24类漏洞的具体覆盖质量未知；使用场景涉及安全测试，需确保合法授权；不构成投资或安全建议。
keyPointsEn: Includes 82 skills and 15 slash commands for the Claude Code environment
Integrates 681 disclosed-report patterns covering 24 core vulnerability classes
Provides enterprise identity and infrastructure attack matrices
cards.whyItMatters: 该技能包将分散的漏洞报告模式与攻击矩阵组织为可调用的Claude Code技能和命令，可能降低漏洞猎人与红队人员在信息检索和流程编排上的重复工作，但实际效果需独立评估。
cards.titleEn: Claude Code Skill Bundle for Bug Hunting and Red Teaming
cards.summaryEn: Project fact: Claude-BugHunter is a skill bundle for Claude Code containing 82 skills, 15 slash commands, and 681 disclosed-report patterns across 24 core vulnerability classes and enterprise identity and infrastructure attack matrices. Author's claim: the bundle serves bug hunting and external red-team work. The above information comes from the GitHub Trending Daily project summary and has not been independently verified.
cards.descriptionEn: This GitHub project packages 82 skills, 15 slash commands, and 681 disclosed-report patterns into a Claude Code skill bundle covering 24 core vulnerability classes plus enterprise identity and infrastructure attack matrices, offering a structured toolkit for bug hunters and external red teams.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The bundle organizes scattered vulnerability report patterns and attack matrices into callable Claude Code skills and commands, potentially reducing repetitive information retrieval and workflow orchestration for bug hunters and red teamers, though its actual effectiveness requires independent evaluation.
cards.title: Claude代码技能包助漏洞猎人与红队作业
cards.limitationsEn: Information comes solely from the GitHub Trending Daily project summary; the bundle's actual content, effectiveness, security, or maintenance status has not been verified; the quality of coverage for the 681 report patterns and 24 vulnerability classes is unknown; use cases involve security testing and require legal authorization; this is not investment or security advice.

cards.description: SheetAlign 提出一种无需微调即可提升开源模型电子表格操作准确率的方法，通过任务引导的检查与 API 锚定，将代码生成与工作簿观察和可用操作对齐，并利用阶段隔离学习与执行一致性进一步优化。该方法在 SpreadsheetBench 上将 Qwen3-4B 的准确率从 13.5% 提升至 29.2%（免训练），结合学习与一致性后达到 32.8%，并在 Domain-Spreadsheet 上达到 30.1%，为本地部署的表格智能体提供了可复现的改进路径。
cards.summary: 论文提出 SheetAlign 框架，核心是围绕“在哪操作、改什么、如何实现”组织阶段隔离的策略学习：任务引导的检查与 API 锚定使代码生成扎根于工作簿观察和可用操作；阶段隔离学习利用编辑进度奖励分别优化程序生成与审阅；推理时通过工作簿状态间的一致性选择程序。在 SpreadsheetBench 上，仅锚定任务接口即可将 Qwen3-4B 的平均准确率从 13.5% 提升至 29.2%（无需训练），结合学习与执行一致性后达到 32.8%，并在 Domain-Spreadsheet 上达到 30.1%，优于同类基线。作者认为该方法能在保护敏感数据和控制部署成本的前提下实现本地化表格分析自动化；上述数字为论文报告结果，其泛化性仍需独立验证。
keyPoints: 任务引导的检查与 API 锚定使代码生成基于工作簿观察和可用操作，免训练即可显著提升 Qwen3-4B 在 SpreadsheetBench 上的准确率（13.5%→29.2%）。
阶段隔离学习分别优化程序生成与审阅，使用编辑进度奖励；推理时通过执行一致性（工作簿状态间的一致性）选择程序，最终在 SpreadsheetBench 上达到 32.8%，在 Domain-Spreadsheet 上达到 30.1%。
框架面向本地部署的开源权重模型，强调保护敏感数据与控制部署成本，代码将在论文发表后公开。
cards.limitations: 证据来自论文在 SpreadsheetBench 和 Domain-Spreadsheet 上的实验，仅涉及 Qwen3-4B 等有限模型和基准；免训练提升与学习后增益的长期稳定性、跨模型和跨领域泛化能力仍需独立复现与验证。代码尚未公开（论文称发表后公开），实际部署效果和计算开销也需进一步评估。
keyPointsEn: Task-guided inspection and API grounding anchor code generation in workbook observations and available operations, improving Qwen3-4B's accuracy on SpreadsheetBench from 13.5% to 29.2% without training.

Stage-isolated learning optimizes program generation and review separately using edit-progress rewards; execution consistency at inference selects programs via agreement among workbook states, achieving 32.8% on SpreadsheetBench and 30.1% on Domain-Spreadsheet.
The framework targets locally deployed open-weight models, emphasizing protection of sensitive data and control of deployment costs; code will be made public upon publication.
cards.whyItMatters: 电子表格广泛用于数据分析和决策支持，但自动化处理常受隐私与成本约束。SheetAlign 为本地部署的开源模型提供了一种无需微调即可提升表格操作准确率的工程化思路，有助于在保护敏感数据的同时降低对闭源 API 的依赖。
cards.titleEn: SheetAlign: Grounded Interaction and Stage-Isolated Learning for Spreadsheet Agents
cards.summaryEn: The paper introduces SheetAlign, a framework organized around where to operate, what to change, and how to implement transformations: task-guided inspection and API grounding anchor code generation in workbook observations and available operations; stage-isolated learning uses edit-progress rewards to optimize program generation and review separately; at inference, execution consistency selects programs via agreement among workbook states. On SpreadsheetBench, the grounded task interface alone improves Qwen3-4B's average accuracy from 13.5% to 29.2% without training, and with learning and execution consistency, SheetAlign achieves 32.8% on average and 30.1% on Domain-Spreadsheet, outperforming comparable baselines. The authors argue this enables locally deployed spreadsheet automation while protecting sensitive data and controlling deployment costs; these numbers are as reported in the paper, and generalization needs independent validation.
cards.descriptionEn: SheetAlign proposes a method to improve spreadsheet manipulation accuracy of open-weight models without fine-tuning by grounding code generation in workbook observations and available APIs, and further optimizing with stage-isolated learning and execution consistency. It raises Qwen3-4B's accuracy on SpreadsheetBench from 13.5% to 29.2% (training-free) and reaches 32.8% with learning and consistency, plus 30.1% on Domain-Spreadsheet, offering a reproducible path for locally d
cards.whyItMattersEn: Spreadsheets are widely used for data analysis and decision support, but automation is often constrained by privacy and cost. SheetAlign offers an engineering approach for locally deployed open-weight models to improve spreadsheet manipulation accuracy without fine-tuning, helping reduce reliance on closed APIs while protecting sensitive data.
cards.title: SheetAlign：面向电子表格智能体的锚定交互与阶段隔离学习
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from experiments on SpreadsheetBench and Domain-Spreadsheet with limited models such as Qwen3-4B; the long-term stability of training-free gains and post-learning improvements, as well as cross-model and cross-domain generalization, still require independent replication and validation. The code is not yet public (to be released upon publication), and practical deployment performance and computational overhead need further evaluation.
cards.originalTitle: SheetAlign: Grounded Interaction and Stage-Isolated Learning for Spreadsheet Agents

cards.description: 该研究提出了TELEVAL基准，用于评估口语语言模型在中文交互场景下的内容可靠性与会话恰当性，弥补了现有基准仅关注任务完成而忽视交互质量的不足。
cards.summary: TELEVAL是一个针对中文口语交互的大型基准，从可靠内容完成和交互恰当性两个维度评估口语语言模型。实验发现，模型在事实问答上的优势无法迁移到中文文化问题和方言语音等场景，且难以根据听觉线索调整回应。作者还记录了一种“字幕陷阱”的失败模式，即模型描述感知到的听觉线索而非回应用户需求。
keyPoints: TELEVAL包含可靠内容完成和交互恰当性两个互补评估维度，无需额外任务提示或预设答案选项。
实验表明，模型在事实问答上的高分不能保证在中文文化知识、方言语音等挑战性场景下的可靠性。
模型即使识别出听觉线索，也难以据此调整回应，并存在“字幕陷阱”的失败模式。
cards.limitations: 研究基于特定基准和实验设置，结论的普适性需进一步验证；未涵盖所有口语交互场景和模型类型，且“字幕陷阱”等发现可能受数据分布影响。
keyPointsEn: TELEVAL covers two complementary evaluation aspects: reliable content fulfillment and interactional appropriateness, without additional task-specific prompts or predefined answer options.
Experiments show that high scores on factual question-answering do not guarantee reliability in challenging scenarios such as Chinese cultural knowledge and dialectal speech.
Models struggle to adapt responses to auditory cues even when they explicitly recognize them, and exhibit a recurring "Caption Trap" failure pattern.
cards.whyItMatters: 该基准为口语语言模型提供了诊断框架，揭示了现有评估方式可能高估模型实际交互能力的问题，有助于推动更贴近真实场景的模型评估与改进。
cards.titleEn: TELEVAL: A Benchmark for Evaluating Chinese Spoken Interaction
cards.summaryEn: TELEVAL is a large-scale benchmark for Chinese spoken interaction that evaluates spoken language models on two complementary aspects: reliable content fulfillment and interactional appropriateness. Experiments reveal that strong performance on factual question-answering does not transfer to culturally relevant knowledge or dialectal speech, and models struggle to adapt responses to auditory cues. The authors also document a recurring failure pattern termed the "Caption Trap", where models describe perceived auditory cues instead of addressing user needs.
cards.descriptionEn: This study introduces TELEVAL, a benchmark for evaluating spoken language models in Chinese interactive scenarios, focusing on content reliability and interactional appropriateness, addressing the gap that existing benchmarks emphasize task completion over interaction quality.
cards.whyItMattersEn: This benchmark provides a diagnostic framework for spoken language models, revealing that existing evaluations may overestimate models' actual interaction capabilities, thereby promoting more realistic model assessment and improvement.
cards.title: TELEVAL：评估中文口语交互的新基准
cards.limitationsEn: The findings are based on a specific benchmark and experimental setup, and their generalizability requires further validation; not all spoken interaction scenarios or model types are covered, and findings such as the "Caption Trap" may be influenced by data distribution.
cards.originalTitle: TELEVAL: A Benchmark Designed for Spoken Language Models in Chinese Interactive Scenarios

cards.description: 该研究在Bates随机波动率跳跃扩散模型中，将隐含波动率曲面与方差期限结构的误差纳入同一校准目标，检验两者权重如何影响拟合与对冲；其价值在于揭示曲面拟合更优并不必然带来更低对冲误差，参数约束方式对期权二次对冲的影响大于权重本身。
cards.summary: 研究在Bates(1996)模型上对1996至2025年标普500指数期权逐日校准，目标函数同时包含隐含波动率曲面误差与方差期限结构(VTS)误差。仅用期权价格校准时模型无法匹配VTS，而给予VTS很小的权重即可显著降低其误差，曲面精度仅小幅下降，对冲表现变化不大。作者报告：受约束校准（现货方差由高频收益估计固定、跳跃幅度分布跨日统一）与不受约束校准的差异对对冲的影响超过权重选择，且对期权价格拟合更近的模型不一定对冲误差更低。
keyPoints: 仅以期权价格校准无法匹配方差期限结构，加入小权重即可大幅降低VTS误差，曲面精度仅小幅受损。
拟合方式对对冲的影响大于权重：不受约束拟合更贴近曲面但隐含罕见且不合理的巨大跳跃；受约束拟合在期权进入二次对冲后误差相当或更低。
VTS惩罚项会压低参数隐含的极端跳跃幅度，但并未显式排除此类跳跃分布。
cards.limitations: 结论基于单一模型（Bates随机波动率跳跃扩散）与标普500指数期权样本（1996–2025），作者自述结果，未涉及其他市场或其他模型设定；受约束校准依赖高频收益估计的现货方差及跨日统一的跳跃幅度分布假设；VTS权重与约束选择对结果的具体敏感度需读者自行核对原文；文中结论不构成任何投资或交易建议。
keyPointsEn: Calibration to option prices alone misses the variance term structure; a small VTS weight sharply cuts its error with only a small loss in surface accuracy.

The calibration scheme matters more for hedging than the weight: unrestricted fits track the surface more closely but imply rare and implausibly large jumps, while restricted fits yield equal or lower hedging errors once options enter the quadratic hedge.
The VTS penalty reduces extreme jump sizes implied by fitted parameters but does not explicitly exclude such jump laws.
cards.whyItMatters: 对冲组合的构建依赖模型拟合出的完整跳跃分布，因此评估校准质量不能只看曲面拟合精度；该研究提示，将期限结构信息与合理的参数约束纳入校准，可能比单纯提高曲面拟合更重要。对量化研究者而言，这为模型校准目标的选择与对冲评估提供了可检验的对照框架。
cards.titleEn: Joint Calibration of Volatility Surface and Variance Term Structure and Its Hedging Implications
cards.summaryEn: Using the Bates (1996) model calibrated daily to S&P 500 index options from 1996 to 2025, the objective combines errors on the implied volatility surface and on the variance term structure (VTS). Calibrated to option prices alone, the model misses the VTS; a small weight on the VTS sharply reduces its error at a small cost in surface accuracy and little change in hedging performance. The author reports that restricted calibration (spot variance pinned to a high-frequency estimate, one jump-size law pooled across dates) versus unrestricted calibration matters more for hedging than the weight, and that a closer fit to option prices does not necessarily imply lower hedging errors.
cards.descriptionEn: The study incorporates implied volatility surface errors and variance term structure (VTS) errors into a single calibration objective for the Bates stochastic volatility jump-diffusion model, examining how their relative weight affects both fit and hedging. Its value lies in showing that a closer surface fit does not necessarily yield lower hedging errors, and that the parameter restriction scheme matters more for quadratic option hedges than the weight itself.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Hedge positions depend on the full fitted jump law, so calibration quality should not be judged by surface fit alone; the study suggests that incorporating term-structure information and sensible parameter restrictions may matter more than tightening surface fit. For quantitative researchers, it offers a testable comparative framework for choosing calibration objectives and evaluating hedges.
cards.title: 波动率曲面与方差期限结构联合校准及其对冲影响
cards.limitationsEn: Results rest on a single model (Bates stochastic volatility jump-diffusion) and one sample of S&P 500 index options (1996–2025) as reported by the author; other markets and model specifications are not examined. The restricted calibration relies on a high-frequency estimate of spot variance and on a single pooled jump-size law across dates. The sensitivity of results to the VTS weight and restriction choices should be checked against the original paper. Nothing here constitutes investment or trading advice.
cards.originalTitle: Joint calibration of the volatility surface and variance term structure

cards.description: 该研究揭示AI交易能力提升可能以私人信息为代价改善个体预测，同时改变价格的信息揭示功能，对理解算法交易的市场影响具有新意。
cards.summary: 研究指出，在资源受限的竞争性预测市场中，更强大的AI算法可能用公共记录分析替代私人观察，从而减少聚合到价格中的私人信息。同时，相同交易可将复杂的公共数据分析传递给无法自行分析的投资者。作者建立了两种效应共存的条件，并发现进一步计算带来的私人收益下降。
keyPoints: AI能力提升可改善个体预测，但可能降低价格对私人信息的聚合程度。
同一交易既可能减少私人信息融入价格，又可能向有限观察者传递公共数据分析价值。
数值均衡计算与神经市场实验显示，AI采用率扩大时，价格对有限观察者预测价值上升，对高级观察者下降，升级收益降低44%。
未升级投资者的再训练可能放大私人信息精度的损失。
cards.limitations: 结论基于数值均衡计算、有限数据神经市场实验、样本外盈利预测和受控语言模型任务，可能受模型设定与实验条件限制；未涉及真实市场长期动态与监管变化，不宜直接作为投资决策依据。
keyPointsEn: Better AI can improve individual forecasts but may reduce the aggregation of private information into prices.
The same trades can both reduce private information in prices and convey public-data analysis value to limited observers.

Numerical equilibrium calculations and neural-market experiments show that wider AI adoption increases price predictive value for limited observers, reduces it for advanced observers, and lowers the benefit of upgrading by 44%.
Retraining by investors who did not upgrade can amplify the loss of private-information precision.
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究提醒，AI交易的信息后果取决于价格揭示的内容以及谁有能力使用这些信息，对评估市场质量和信息公平性具有意义。
cards.titleEn: Informational Effects of AI Trading: Trade-off Between Public Data Analysis and Private Information Aggregation
cards.summaryEn: In a competitive forecasting market with resource constraints, more capable AI algorithms may substitute public-record analysis for private observations, reducing private information aggregated into prices. The same trades can convey sophisticated public-data analysis to investors unable to perform it themselves. The author establishes conditions under which these effects coexist and finds that the private benefit of further computation falls.
cards.descriptionEn: The study reveals that improved AI trading may enhance individual forecasts at the cost of private information, while altering the informational role of prices, offering new insights into algorithmic trading's market impact.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study cautions that the informational consequences of AI trading depend on what prices reveal and who can use them, which matters for assessing market quality and information fairness.
cards.title: AI交易的信息效应：公共数据分析与私人信息聚合的权衡
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions are based on numerical equilibrium calculations, finite-data neural-market experiments, out-of-sample earnings forecasts, and controlled language-model tasks, and may be limited by model settings and experimental conditions; they do not address long-term real-market dynamics or regulatory changes and should not be used directly for investment decisions.
cards.originalTitle: The opposing informational effects of AI trading

cards.description: 该研究基于指数加权第二矩矩阵的主成分构建自适应特征组合（EWMA-PC1），并与市值加权（SPY）和等权（RSP）基准比较贝塔对冲表现。新意在于区分市场成分提取与增量对冲效果，对量化对冲策略的基准选择有参考价值。
cards.summary: 研究构建了基于EWMA主成分的特征组合EWMA-PC1，并在随机生成的不同规模与权重股票组合上检验其贝塔对冲效果。结果显示，EWMA-PC1在方差削减和残差相关性上优于SPY，但相对RSP的优势较小且混合。作者认为基准加权方式和目标组合构成会影响对冲评估，但结论仅涉及统计风险削减，未计入交易等成本。
keyPoints: EWMA-PC1在全部测试配置下方差削减均值高于SPY，50只股票Dirichlet组合中达92.17%对79.03%。
EWMA-PC1对RSP的增量优势较小且混合，RSP在多股票流动性倾斜组合上方差削减更高。
统计上对SPY的改善证据比RSP更一致，基准选择显著影响结论。
cards.limitations: 结果仅基于历史S&P 500成分股，未考虑交易、融资和借券成本；统计推断采用块自助法，结论依赖于随机组合生成方式；未涵盖样本外或实盘验证，且作者明确指出区分市场成分提取与增量对冲效果。
keyPointsEn: EWMA-PC1 achieves higher mean variance reduction than SPY across all tested configurations, reaching 92.17% vs 79.03% for 50-stock Dirichlet portfolios.
Its incremental advantage over RSP is small and mixed; RSP achieves greater variance reduction for multi-stock liquidity-tilted portfolios.
Statistical evidence of improvement is more consistent against SPY than RSP, highlighting the impact of benchmark choice.
cards.whyItMatters: 为量化对冲策略中市场基准的选择提供了实证参考，提示自适应特征组合可能比市值加权基准更有效，但相对等权基准的优势有限，需结合目标组合特征评估。
cards.titleEn: EWMA Principal Eigenportfolios Improve Equity Beta Hedging
cards.summaryEn: The study builds EWMA-PC1, an eigenportfolio based on EWMA principal components, and tests its beta-hedging performance on randomly generated portfolios of varying sizes and weighting schemes. EWMA-PC1 outperforms SPY in variance reduction and residual correlation, but its advantage over RSP is smaller and mixed. The authors note that benchmark weighting and target portfolio composition affect hedging evaluation, and results cover only statistical risk reduction excluding trading costs.
cards.descriptionEn: This study constructs an adaptive eigenportfolio (EWMA-PC1) from the leading principal component of an exponentially weighted second-moment matrix and compares its beta-hedging performance with capitalization-weighted (SPY) and equal-weighted (RSP) benchmarks. Its novelty lies in distinguishing market component extraction from incremental hedge effectiveness, offering insights for benchmark selection in quantitative hedging strategies.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Provides empirical evidence for benchmark selection in quantitative hedging strategies, suggesting adaptive eigenportfolios may be more effective than capitalization-weighted benchmarks, but their advantage over equal-weighted benchmarks is limited and depends on target portfolio characteristics.
cards.title: EWMA主特征组合提升股票贝塔对冲效果
cards.limitationsEn: Results are based on historical S&P 500 constituents and exclude trading, financing, and borrowing costs; inference uses block bootstrap and depends on random portfolio generation; no out-of-sample or live validation is provided, and the authors explicitly distinguish market component extraction from incremental hedge effectiveness.
cards.originalTitle: EWMA Principal Eigenportfolios of Equity Returns: Market Representation and Beta-Hedging Performance

cards.description: 本文用2021—2025年USDT、USDC、BUSD的日度数据，以代币数量变动而非市值衡量资金流，避免脱锚时市值口径误记的虚假流入；进而检验稳定币挤兑是否携带美国国库券收益率信息。其价值在于区分恐慌型挤兑与监管事件，并给出可供央行监测参考的规模阈值。
cards.summary: 研究以代币单位变化度量稳定币资金流，剔除脱锚时市值口径的虚假流入。正常时期资金流与收益率无稳定关系；在三次恐慌型挤兑中，5日10亿美元赎回对应10个交易日内3个月国库券收益率下降8.5个基点，而两次监管事件无此信号。作者将此解读为避险（flight to quality），并认为该效应主要由TerraUSD崩溃事件驱动，USDC/SVB挤兑提供佐证。
keyPoints: 以代币数量变动而非市值衡量资金流，剔除脱锚期间的虚假流入。
仅恐慌驱动的三次挤兑出现显著信号：5日10亿美元赎回对应10个交易日内3个月国库券收益率降8.5个基点；两次监管事件无此信号。
反应跨期限普遍存在且符号与储备抛售预期相反，作者据此指向避险；恐慌期5日赎回约20至30亿美元被视为具监测意义的规模。
cards.limitations: 证据仅来自USDT、USDC、BUSD三个稳定币、2021—2025年样本与五个事件，属事件层面证据，不能外推至其他稳定币或时期。效应主要由TerraUSD崩溃单个事件驱动，样本事件数少，因果识别有限；8.5个基点与20至30亿美元阈值为样本内估计，需更多事件与更长样本验证。结论为作者解读，不构成投资建议。
keyPointsEn: Flows are measured from changes in token units rather than market capitalisation, removing phantom inflows during depegs.

Only the three panic-driven runs show a significant signal: a five-day USD 1 billion redemption corresponds to an 8.5 basis point fall in the three-month bill yield within ten trading days; two regulatory episodes show no such signal.

The response is broad across maturities and has the opposite sign to reserve liquidation, which the authors read as flight to quality; panic-period five-day redemptions of roughly USD 2 to 3 billion mark a surveillance-relevant scale.
cards.whyItMatters: 若恐慌期稳定币赎回能提前或同步反映国库券收益率变化，央行可将稳定币资金流纳入监测指标，补充对短期融资市场压力的观察；而区分恐慌型与监管型事件，有助于避免把常规监管冲击误读为市场压力信号。
cards.titleEn: Stablecoin Runs as Signals of Safe-Asset Stress: Panic-Episode Evidence for Central Bank Surveillance
cards.summaryEn: The study measures stablecoin flows via changes in token units, removing market-cap-based phantom inflows during depegs. Flows show no stable relationship with yields in normal periods; in three panic-driven runs, a five-day USD 1 billion redemption is associated with an 8.5 basis point fall in the three-month bill yield within ten trading days, while two regulatory episodes show no such signal. The authors interpret this as flight to quality, led by the TerraUSD collapse and corroborated by the USDC/SVB run.
cards.descriptionEn: Using daily USDT, USDC and BUSD data from 2021 to 2025, the paper measures flows from changes in token units rather than market capitalisation, avoiding the phantom inflows recorded when tokens lose their peg, and tests whether stablecoin runs carry information about U.S. Treasury yields. Its value lies in separating panic-driven runs from regulatory episodes and offering a scale threshold relevant to central bank monitoring.
cards.whyItMattersEn: If stablecoin redemptions during panics reflect Treasury yield movements, central banks could add stablecoin flows to their monitoring toolkit for short-term funding stress; distinguishing panic-driven from regulatory episodes helps avoid misreading routine regulatory shocks as market stress signals.
cards.title: 稳定币挤兑与美国国库券收益率：恐慌期信号与监管含义
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence covers only USDT, USDC and BUSD over 2021-2025 and five episodes, so it is episode-level evidence that cannot be generalised to other stablecoins or periods. The effect is driven mainly by the single TerraUSD collapse, with few events and limited causal identification; the 8.5 basis point and USD 2-3 billion thresholds are in-sample estimates needing more events and longer samples. The interpretation is the authors' and does not constitute investment advice.
cards.originalTitle: Stablecoin Runs as Safe-Asset Stress Signals: Episode-Level Evidence for Central Bank Surveillance

cards.description: 该研究将远期利率曲线模型扩展至多国政府债券市场，发现跨国实现收益率变化的相关矩阵块在不同期限之间存在显著不对称性；模型为每个国家赋予一个特质时间尺度，用以解释这种不对称，并同时捕捉日频与日内全曲线相关性，在欧元区九国国债上校准的典型重建误差为1.7%。
cards.summary: 文章将Baaquie与Bouchaud（2004）及Le Coz与Bouchaud（2024）的远期利率曲线模型推广到多国政府债券市场。作者报告跨国实现收益率变化相关矩阵块在期限之间呈现显著不对称性，并在模型中通过给每个国家一个特质时间尺度来复现这一结构。模型同时捕捉日频和日内全曲线相关性，在欧元区九国国债上校准的典型重建误差为1.7%。
keyPoints: 跨国实现收益率变化的相关矩阵块在不同期限之间存在显著不对称性。
模型为每个国家引入一个特质时间尺度，以刻画未来日期之间感知时间如何依赖日期本身，并由此复现跨国相关矩阵的特征不对称。
模型同时捕捉全部跨曲线相关性，并在日频与日内频率上均适用；在欧元区九国国债上校准的典型重建误差为1.7%。
cards.limitations: 证据边界包括：模型基于特定远期利率曲线框架的扩展，校准与误差结果仅来自欧元区九国政府债券样本；1.7%为典型重建误差，未说明在不同国家、期限或频率下的分布与稳健性；摘要未报告样本外预测表现、极端市场条件下的稳定性或与其他多国曲线模型的系统比较。
keyPointsEn: Cross-country blocks of realized yield change correlation matrices display significant asymmetry between maturities.

The model introduces an idiosyncratic time scale for each country to describe how the perceived time between future dates depends on the dates themselves, thereby reproducing the characteristic asymmetry of cross-country correlation matrices.

The model captures the full set of cross-curve correlations simultaneously at both daily and intra-day frequencies; calibrated on government bonds from nine euro-zone countries, the typical reconstruction error is 1.7%.
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架为多国政府债券曲线之间的相关性结构提供了可解释的参数化方式，有助于在跨国债券组合与风险管理中同时处理日频和日内频率的曲线交互，并在欧元区九国样本上给出了可量化的拟合精度参考。
cards.titleEn: Multi-Country Government Bond Yield Curve Model: Cross-Country Correlation Asymmetry Explained by Country-Specific Time Scales
cards.summaryEn: The article extends the forward rate curve model of Baaquie and Bouchaud (2004) and Le Coz and Bouchaud (2024) to the multi-country setting of government bond markets. The author reports significant asymmetry between maturities in cross-country blocks of realized yield change correlation matrices and reproduces this structure in the model by giving each country an idiosyncratic time scale. The model captures the full set of cross-curve correlations at both daily and intra-day frequencies, with a typical reconstruction error of 1.7% when calibrated on government bonds issued by nine euro-zone countries.
cards.descriptionEn: The study extends a forward rate curve model to the multi-country setting of government bond markets and finds significant asymmetry between maturities in cross-country blocks of realized yield change correlation matrices. The model assigns each country an idiosyncratic time scale to explain this asymmetry and captures the full set of cross-curve correlations at both daily and intra-day frequencies, with a typical reconstruction error of 1.7% when calibrated on government bon
cards.whyItMattersEn: The framework provides an interpretable parameterization of the correlation structure across multi-country government bond curves, which can help handle curve interactions at both daily and intra-day frequencies in cross-country bond portfolios and risk management, and offers a quantifiable fitting accuracy reference on the nine euro-zone sample.
cards.title: 多国国债收益率曲线模型：跨国相关矩阵的不对称性可由国别时间尺度解释
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundaries include: the model is an extension of a specific forward rate curve framework, and the calibration and error results come only from a sample of nine euro-zone government bond markets; the 1.7% is a typical reconstruction error without reporting its distribution or robustness across countries, maturities, or frequencies; the abstract does not report out-of-sample forecasting performance, stability under extreme market conditions, or systematic comparison with other multi-country curve models.
cards.originalTitle: Bond yield dynamics: a multi-country multi-horizon string model

cards.description: 该研究将1912年和1921年版《美国医学目录》的机器转录与人工全量双录入结果进行对比，发现基于规则的OCR解析流程能恢复约97%的人工转录记录，且与多模态LLM工作流的失败记录部分重叠，合并两者输出可将召回率和精确率提升至约98%。
cards.summary: 研究比较了五种机器提取流程与人工双录入在历史医学名录数字化中的一致性。基于编码代理编写规则的OCR解析流程召回率约97%，优于多模态LLM工作流；合并两者输出可将召回率和精确率提升至约98%。由于人工转录本身的错误率未知，这些指标衡量的是与人工转录的一致性而非绝对准确率。
keyPoints: 基于规则解析商业OCR文本的流程恢复约97%人工转录记录，精确率相近，优于多模态LLM（gemini-2.0.flash）工作流。
两种方法失败记录部分重叠，合并输出可将召回率和精确率均提升至约98%。
本地GPU运行的开源权重LLM流程召回率介于规则解析器和多模态工作流之间；以开源OCR替代商业OCR仅降低约2个百分点召回率。
cards.limitations: 人工转录的错误率未知，因此报告的比例衡量的是机器输出与人工转录之间的一致性，而非相对真实值的准确率。研究仅针对《美国医学目录》两个年份的版本，结论向其他历史名录或文献类型的推广需谨慎。
keyPointsEn: A rule-based pipeline parsing commercial OCR text recovers about 97% of manually transcribed records with similar precision, outperforming a multimodal LLM (gemini-2.0.flash) workflow.
The two methods fail on partly overlapping record sets, and reconciling their outputs raises both recall and precision to about 98%.

An open-weight LLM pipeline run locally falls between the parser and the multimodal workflow in recall; replacing commercial OCR with an open-source alternative lowers recall by only about 2 percentage points.
cards.whyItMatters: 对大规模历史名录数字化而言，机器转录与人工转录高度一致，且直接处理成本（约0.03欧元/页）远低于人工转录（约14.70欧元/页），为类似半结构化历史文献的数字化提供了可参考的效率与一致性证据。
cards.titleEn: AI and LLM Transcription of a Historical Medical Directory: Agreement with Manual Double-Entry
cards.summaryEn: The study compares five machine extraction workflows with manual double-entry for digitizing a historical medical directory. A rule-based OCR parsing pipeline achieves about 97% recall, outperforming a multimodal LLM workflow, and reconciling the two raises both recall and precision to around 98%. Because the manual transcription's own error rate is unknown, these rates measure agreement with manual transcription rather than absolute accuracy.
cards.descriptionEn: This study compares machine transcription of the 1912 and 1921 American Medical Directory against full-count manual double-entry, finding that a rule-based OCR parsing pipeline recovers about 97% of manually transcribed records and that combining its output with a multimodal LLM workflow raises recall and precision to about 98%.
cards.whyItMattersEn: For large-scale digitization of historical directories, machine transcription shows high agreement with manual transcription at a direct processing cost of about 0.03 euro per page versus 14.70 euro per page for manual transcription, offering evidence on efficiency and agreement for similar semi-structured historical documents.
cards.title: AI与LLM转录历史医学名录：与人工双录入一致性比较
cards.limitationsEn: The manual transcription's own error rate is unknown, so the reported rates measure agreement between machine output and manual transcription rather than accuracy against ground truth. The study covers only two editions of the American Medical Directory, and generalization to other historical directories or document types requires caution.
cards.originalTitle: The American Medical Directory Panel: Comparing AI-Assisted and LLM Transcription with Manual Data Entry at Scale

cards.description: 该论文在机制转换框架下构建了一般切换模型，给出了最优对数投资组合存在的充要条件，并量化了机制转换的随机性及内在风险对最大期望对数效用增量的影响。
cards.summary: 论文研究由连续时间马尔可夫链驱动的机制转换市场模型，其中投资者可在多个半鞅模型间切换。作者定义了一般切换模型，并推导出最优对数投资组合存在的充要条件，同时量化了机制转换的随机性及其内在风险对最大期望对数效用增量的贡献。作者观点认为这些结果刻画了切换机制对投资组合决策的影响，但具体结论依赖于模型设定。
keyPoints: 构建了覆盖现有情形的一般切换模型，并分析其对数最优投资组合。
给出了保证最优投资组合存在的充要条件，涉及模型族与马尔可夫链的联合性质。
量化了机制转换随机性及内在风险对最大期望对数效用增量的影响。
cards.limitations: 论文为理论分析，结论依赖于半鞅模型族和连续时间马尔可夫链的设定；未涉及参数估计、模型误设或实证表现，实际应用需进一步验证。
keyPointsEn: A general switching model covering existing cases is constructed, and its log-optimal portfolio is analyzed.
Necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of the optimal portfolio are given, involving joint properties of the model family and the Markov chain.
The impact of regime-switching stochasticity and intrinsic risks on the increment in maximum expected logarithmic utility is quantified.
cards.whyItMatters: 为机制转换市场中的对数最优投资策略提供了理论刻画，有助于理解状态切换风险如何影响长期财富增长。
cards.summaryEn: The paper studies regime-switching market models driven by a continuous-time Markov chain, where an agent can switch among multiple semimartingale models. The authors define a general switching model, derive necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of the log-optimal portfolio, and quantify the contribution of regime-switching stochasticity and intrinsic risks to the increment in maximum expected logarithmic utility. The authors' view is that these results characterize the impact of switching mechanisms on portfolio decisions, but the conclusions depend on model specifications.
cards.descriptionEn: The paper constructs a general switching model under regime switching and provides necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of the log-optimal portfolio, quantifying how regime-switching stochasticity and intrinsic risks affect the increment in maximum expected logarithmic utility.
cards.whyItMattersEn: It provides a theoretical characterization of log-optimal investment strategies in regime-switching markets, helping to understand how state-switching risk affects long-term wealth growth.
cards.title: 机制转换市场中的对数最优投资组合研究
cards.limitationsEn: The paper is theoretical; conclusions rely on the setting of semimartingale model families and continuous-time Markov chains. Parameter estimation, model misspecification, and empirical performance are not addressed, and practical application requires further validation.
cards.originalTitle: Log-optimal portfolios for market models with regime switching

cards.description: 该GitHub项目为Claude Code、Codex等七种AI编程助手提供编辑级图表设计方案，支持45种图表类型，输出自包含的HTML+SVG，强调无阴影、拒绝Mermaid风格。
cards.summary: 这是一个面向AI编程助手的图表设计资源库，提供45种图表类型的编辑级设计规范，输出为自包含的HTML+SVG。项目明确反对阴影效果和简单的Mermaid式图表，声称适配Claude Code、Codex、GitHub Copilot、Cursor、Factory Droid、Qoder和Pi等工具。以上信息来自项目自述，未经独立验证。
keyPoints: 支持45种图表类型，输出自包含HTML+SVG
明确反对阴影效果和简单化Mermaid图表风格
声称适配Claude Code、Codex、GitHub Copilot等七种AI编程助手
cards.limitations: 所有信息均来自GitHub项目自述，未提供独立评测或对比数据；45种图表类型的具体内容和编辑级设计的实际效果未经验证；对七种AI编程助手的适配程度仅为声称，缺乏具体集成案例或用户反馈。
keyPointsEn: Supports 45 diagram types with self-contained HTML+SVG output
Explicitly rejects shadow effects and simplistic Mermaid diagram style
Claims compatibility with seven AI coding assistants including Claude Code and Codex
cards.whyItMatters: 为使用AI编程助手生成图表的开发者提供了一套强调编辑设计感的参考方案，可能有助于改善AI生成图表的视觉质量，但其实际效果和适用性需用户自行评估。
cards.titleEn: Editorial Diagram Design Resource for AI Coding Assistants
cards.summaryEn: This is a diagram design resource for AI coding assistants, offering editorial design specifications for 45 diagram types with self-contained HTML+SVG output. The project explicitly rejects shadows and simplistic Mermaid-style diagrams, and claims compatibility with tools such as Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. All information comes from the project's self-description and has not been independently verified.
cards.descriptionEn: This GitHub project provides editorial diagram design for seven AI coding assistants including Claude Code and Codex, supports 45 diagram types, outputs self-contained HTML+SVG, emphasizes no shadows, and rejects Mermaid-style diagrams.
cards.whyItMattersEn: It provides developers using AI coding assistants with a reference solution emphasizing editorial design for generated diagrams, potentially improving visual quality, though actual effectiveness and applicability require user evaluation.
cards.title: 面向AI编程助手的编辑级图表设计资源库
cards.limitationsEn: All information comes from the GitHub project's self-description, with no independent evaluation or comparative data; the specific content of the 45 diagram types and the actual effect of editorial design are unverified; compatibility with the seven AI coding assistants is claimed only, lacking concrete integration cases or user feedback.

cards.description: 该项目汇总了 124 种有文档记录的应用商店拒审模式及修复方法，提供预提交检查、隐私清单与数据安全核查，并追踪 112 个监管截止日期，还包含面向 AI 编码代理的技能。
cards.summary: GitHub 项目 mjmirza/app-store-compliance 提供开源的应用商店合规手册，包含 124 种有文档记录的拒审模式及修复方案，并附带预提交守卫工具。该项目还涵盖隐私清单和数据安全检查，追踪 112 个监管截止日期（如欧盟 AI 法案、DSA、COPPA、年龄相关法律），并为 AI 编码代理提供一个技能。作者将这些内容定位为帮助开发者避免常见拒审的开放资源。
keyPoints: 收录 124 种有文档记录的 App Store 和 Google Play 拒审模式及对应修复方法
提供预提交守卫工具，包含隐私清单和 Data safety 检查
追踪 112 个监管截止日期，涉及欧盟 AI 法案、DSA、COPPA 和年龄法律
包含一个面向 AI 编码代理的技能，用于辅助合规检查
cards.limitations: 该内容来自 GitHub 仓库的项目自述，尚未提供独立验证或第三方评估。所列拒审模式、修复方案和监管截止日期的准确性需以官方商店政策和法规原文为准。该资源不构成法律建议，开发者应结合自身情况咨询专业意见。
keyPointsEn: Covers 124 documented App Store and Google Play rejection patterns with corresponding fixes
Provides a pre-submission guard tool including privacy manifest and Data safety checks
Tracks 112 regulatory deadlines involving the EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, and age laws
Includes a skill for AI coding agents to assist with compliance checks
cards.whyItMatters: 移动应用开发者常因合规问题遭遇应用商店拒审，该资源将拒审模式、修复方案与监管截止日期集中整理，有助于在提交前识别风险。
cards.titleEn: Open-Source App Store Compliance Playbook: 124 Rejection Patterns and Fixes
cards.summaryEn: The GitHub project mjmirza/app-store-compliance provides an open-source compliance playbook for app stores, featuring 124 documented rejection patterns and fixes along with a pre-submission guard tool. It also covers privacy manifest and data safety checks, tracks 112 regulatory deadlines (such as the EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, and age-related laws), and offers a skill for AI coding agents. The author positions the content as an open resource to help developers avoid common rejections.
cards.descriptionEn: This project compiles 124 documented app store rejection patterns with fixes, offers pre-submission checks for privacy manifests and data safety, tracks 112 regulatory deadlines, and includes a skill for AI coding agents.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Mobile app developers often face app store rejections due to compliance issues; this resource consolidates rejection patterns, fixes, and regulatory deadlines to help identify risks before submission.
cards.title: 开源应用商店合规手册：124 种拒审模式与修复方案
cards.limitationsEn: The content comes from a GitHub repository's project description and has not been independently verified or third-party evaluated. The accuracy of the listed rejection patterns, fixes, and regulatory deadlines should be confirmed against official store policies and legal texts. This resource does not constitute legal advice; developers should consult professionals for their specific situations.
